name: Mitch
message: To My Family. You are my greatest blessing. Life feels complete because I have you both by my side. To my wife—you are the heart of our home, the one who gives love and warmth to everything we do. To my son—you are our joy, our light, and the reason our days are filled with laughter and meaning.

Weekend adventures - Exploring the world hand in hand.

Our little miracle - You complete our family.

name: Babe
message:
From the moment you came into my life, everything changed. You showed me what real love means — not just in grand moments, but in the little things: your laughter, your presence, your warmth. You make even my hardest days feel lighter. Hindi ko kayang isipin ang future ko nang wala ka. I want to build my dreams with you, grow old with you, and face every chapter of life hand in hand. You’re my best friend, my peace, and my greatest blessing. Para sa atin — sa ating pag-ibig na totoo at walang hanggan, to the beautiful journey ahead, and to the forever we’ll create together.
I love you, always. ❤️
captions: Our first date - You are so beautiful. I couldn't stop staring.
The proposal - My hands were shaking. You said yes.
Celebrating together - The moment you said 'YES!' changed everything.
Our announcement - Telling the world about our little miracle.
The restaurant setup - I had them write 'Will you marry me?' on the plate.
Forever together - This is what love looks like.
